redfin.remarks: Welcome to this inviting Glendale condominium offering comfortable living, modern conveniences, and an exceptional location near some of the city’s most popular shopping, dining, entertainment, and transportation destinations. Situated just minutes from The Americana at Brand, Glendale Galleria, major freeways, and an abundance of restaurants, shops, and everyday amenities, this condo provides an ideal combination of convenience and accessibility. The interior features beautiful wood flooring, a freshly painted interior, recessed lighting, and a newer central air conditioning and heating for year-round comfort. The well-appointed kitchen offers stone countertops, a stove, and dishwasher, with ample space for meal preparation and storage. Convenient stackable laundry is located in the hallway, adding practicality without sacrificing living space. The spacious primary bedroom features a wall closet plus a secondary closet and direct access to a private en-suite bathroom complete with a tub and overhead shower, ventilation fan, and a clean, functional layout. The second bedroom offers a wall closet providing excellent storage and flexibility for guests, family members, or a home office. A second bathroom features a walk-in shower and ventilation fan. There is also ample outdoor space off the living room sliding doors that lead to an open air patio area. The building only has six units total and the monthly HOA dues are a very reasonable $411 which covers water, general maintenance and insurance. The property also includes two deeded side-by-side subterranean parking spaces, numbered 1 and 2, providing secure and convenient parking along with a spacious storage cabinet above parking spaces for extra storage. With its desirable Glendale location, comfortable floor plan and move in ready condition. .. this is the condo you have been looking for and don't want to miss!
